_note: Aishwarya Dental palette v2 (26 Oct 2026, owner asked for a dental look that differs from the teal, blue and green used by the other ClinicFlow247 clinic sites): violet taken from the clinic's own name label on Dr. Aishwarya's photo, on clean clinical white with lavender tints. primary = buttons, links, the main call to action (white text). 'navy' keeps its key name for the shared components but is a deep violet-ink here (footer, dark bands). 'cta' is a light lilac ACCENT for icons/numbers on dark bands and soft fills (graphite ctaInk text on it); the main button is primary (src/app/globals.css .btn-cta). 'mint' keys are lavender tints: decoration only on light backgrounds, as text only on navy (mintOnDark). Colours become CSS variables (src/lib/theme.ts) and the ClinicFlow white-label theme tokens (npm run tenant). Run `npm run contrast` after any change.
